waypoints.name: Blue Lake Trailhead
waypoints.note: Signed trailhead on SR-20 ~1 mi west of Washington Pass; follow Blue Lake Trail then the climber's path up to the Liberty Bell-Concord gully.
waypoints.directions: From Winthrop, drive SR 20 west about 30 miles, over Washington Pass, to the signed Blue Lake Trailhead about a mile west of the pass, at about 5,400 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass or day-use fee is required to park.

waypoints.name: Concord Tower Summit
waypoints.note: Shared summit; Cave Route is an alternative line used when Liberty Bell is crowded.
waypoints.directions: Hike the Blue Lake Trail about 1.5 miles to a small meadow, take the climbers' path just past a small stream, and climb slabs, talus and meadow up the gully to the Liberty Bell-Concord notch, often snowy and icy into late June. From the notch drop about 50 ft down the gully on Concord's north side to two diagonal cracks, and climb the three pitches through the cave to the summit.
